content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to import a UDF that I previously used before formatting my computer. There are no errors shown, but the item doesn't appear in the UDF section. I also tried creating a new UDF from scratch and saved the file, but it still doesn't show up. Has anyone else had this issue?
Which module type did you select? UDFs are not visible in [product_name] under version [version_no]. [user_name] (translated with Google)
I'm using [product_name] version [version_no]. With these settings, it was working before.
Try adding the folder that contains the UDFs to the interface.
I tried that too, but nothing appears.
I found a solution—uninstalled the entire application and reinstalled it. Not sure what caused the issue, but after a fresh install, it started working.
That's not accurate... See attached screenshot from [product_name] version [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The issue involved difficulty importing and viewing UDF files after system reinstallation, with no error messages provided. Several troubleshooting steps, including creating new files and integrating folders, failed to resolve the visibility problem. Only a complete reinstallation of the software restored functionality. Inconsistent UI feedback led to user frustration and disrupted workflow.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to seamlessly import and view UDFs within the software interface, without the need for error messages or complicated troubleshooting. They anticipate reliable and predictable software behavior when managing UDF files.
